# 一加6 Linux 与 Docker、Hermes、WeChat 整合图谱

## 系统整体结构
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    D1["OnePlus 6"] --> OS["postmarketOS (Linux)"]
    OS --> T1["Terminal / SSH"]
    T1 --> DCK["Docker Engine"]
    DCK --> C1["Docker Container A"]
    DCK --> C2["Docker Container B"]
    OS --> HERM["Hermes Agent"]
    HERM --> WX["WeChat 集成"]
    WX --> MAC["Mac (同局域网)"]
    D1 --> BAT["电池（便携）"]
    OS --> SWP["11 GB Swap"]
    OS --> STG["7.37 GB 存储 (2.3 GB 已用)"]
    OS --> RAM["8 GB RAM"]
```

## WeChat 与 Hermes 交互流程
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    WM["WeChat 消息"] --> HAG["Hermes Agent (设备)"]
    HAG --> CMD["解析指令（如获取文件）"]
    CMD --> MACAPP["Mac 上的应用"]
    MACAPP --> FILE["目标文件 (MD/Word)"]
    FILE --> SEND["发送文件至 WeChat"]
    SEND --> RESP["WeChat 返回确认"]
    RESP --> WM
```

## Docker 与 F2P 使用场景
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    DCK["Docker Engine"] --> CON1["容器 1（服务）"]
    DCK --> CON2["容器 2（脚本）"]
    DCK --> F2P["F2P (Aliyun 2 GB)"]
    F2P --> LS["大型服务部署"]
    LS --> RUN["在 OnePlus 6 上运行"]
    RUN --> ADV["便携、续航优势"]
    RES["8 GB vs 2 GB 资源对比"] --> RUN
```
